Hi there. Yet again I find myself completely despairing with Kapur Family Care, and wondering why I ever even bother with the surgery at all.

In an attempt to avoid the hassle with yourselves, I tried getting help from Tesco's pharmacy, and also the Well Pharmacy in Market Square, Royton, on the Tuesday 9th July  with regards to a very swollen ear that was potentially infected.
I was informed however to speak to a GP as Pharmacy First don't deal with ear infections.

On Wednesday 10th July I filled in your online triage form to enquire about the potential need for antibiotics.
I received a text response saying that the surgery would ring me on Friday 12th July to discuss my issue. I wasn't totally happy with the fact I had a 2 day wait, however I left well alone and thought hey ho at least I can speak to the doctor, hopefully it won't go any worse.
Friday 12th July came and went. No phone call. No missed phone call either.
The weekend came and went. I anticipated I'd maybe get a call on Monday 15th July (with the hope of an apology into the bargain) even though by now my ear was almost back to normal.
Tuesday 16th, Wednesday 17th, and Thursday 18th have also now passed, and I've heard not one thing from the surgery. It's a good job that my ear went right on its own!

Nearly every time I have an interaction with your surgery I find myself incredibly disappointed and wonder why I even bother.
Yours in
